answer:
Headline results of run /home/hyoklee/poro/agent/results/run_20261115T155359Z_s20 (PoroTomo DAS, Brady Hot Springs, March 2016):

RECORDS & ANOMALIES
- Records analysed: 759 (stride 20; 2016-03-18T02:09:17Z to 2016-03-26T00:59:44Z; 3.314% of the time window)
- Anomalous records (|robust z| > 5): 57
- DAS detections: 62 detections in 53 records; relative b = 0.9849 (34 above Mc)

INJECTION / EXTRACTION CONTEXT
- Injected 4.654e+05 m3, extracted 5.059e+05 m3, net -4.048e+04 m3 over 15.96 days (net extraction, not injection)
- LBNL/NCEDC (GDR 859) March 2016 catalogue: 5 events, ML -0.48 to 0.07

CALIBRATED PROBABILITY (catalogue-based, Shapiro et al. 2021 Eq. 5 — this is the calibrated estimate):
- b = 1.0:  Sigma = -5.449, P(M>=5.5)/yr = 0.0001198, P(M>=5.5) for observed volume = 5.236e-06, P(M>=3)/yr = 0.03719
- b = 0.73: Sigma = -5.319, P(M>=5.5)/yr = 0.004922,  P(M>=5.5) for observed volume = 0.0002155, P(M>=3)/yr = 0.2809
- b = 0.65: Sigma = -5.281, P(M>=5.5)/yr = 0.01474,   P(M>=5.5) for observed volume = 0.0006484, P(M>=3)/yr = 0.4653

DAS-BASED UPPER BOUND (uncalibrated magnitudes; every DAS detection counted as an event at or above the catalogue Mc, so it over-counts — this is the upper bound, NOT calibrated):
- b = 0.9849, Sigma = -2.698, P(M>=5.5)/yr = 0.07842

BOTTOM LINE: The calibrated catalogue-based estimate says a Pohang-like Mw >= 5.5 earthquake is very unlikely (P ~ 1.2e-4 to 1.5e-2 per year depending on b, ~5e-6 to 6.5e-4 over the observed volume). The DAS-based number (0.078/yr) is an upper bound only, inflated by uncalibrated magnitudes and over-counting of detections. With net fluid extraction over the period and only 5 small catalogue events (ML <= 0.07), the data do not show strong evidence of injection-induced seismicity at Brady Hot Springs in March 2016.
